subtitle: Master smooth, connected playing through slides, hammer-ons, and pull-offs. Create vocal-like phrasing and expressive melodic lines.

introduction.title: Why Legato Matters
introduction.text: Legato playing connects separate notes into continuous, singing musical lines by substituting right-hand pick strokes with fret-hand hammer-ons, pull-offs, and lateral fret slides. Minimizing repetitive pick transients produces a softer attack, increased phrase speed, and a smooth vocal quality that elevates lead solos and melodic fills.

columns.title: Musical Expression
columns.text: Legato techniques allow for smooth, vocal-like phrasing that connects notes naturally and expressively.

columns.title: Technical Efficiency
columns.text: Reducing pick attacks creates faster, more fluid passages while adding dynamic variety to your playing.
